{{Infobox auto}}

'''Rind jam''' is the preservation of the [[melon]]. It heals {{Value|Rind Jam|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Fire Resistance}} for {{Value|Rind Jam|duration|effect=Fire Resistance}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/rind_jam.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A raw melon slice, sugar and a glass bottle. Picking up a melon slice unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating rind jam takes {{Value|Rind Jam|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Rind Jam|heals}} and gives Fire Resistance for {{Value|Rind Jam|duration|effect=Fire Resistance|format=clock}}. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.
